'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Dirk Pommerenke LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Pommerenke]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Pommerenke]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
